caption: The drawing depicts a garment resembling a light-colored or off-white top with long sleeves and decorative details. The garment features a high, rounded neckline with a scalloped edge, and a central opening with a similarly scalloped trim running vertically down the front. On either side of the chest, there are symmetrical embroidered patterns that resemble small branches with clustered berries or flowers. The sleeves appear to be slightly gathered at the shoulders, and each sleeve ends in a large, rectangular cuff that is also edged with a scalloped border and embroidered with an oval filigree design. The lower portion of the garment is depicted with vertical folds or pleats, suggesting fullness or an underlayer. The composition of the drawing is centered, with the garment occupying the majority of the space on an unadorned background. The colors used are primarily shades of beige and light gray, with darker lines to emphasize the embroidery and pleated details. The artist's signature "S. Ex Bush" is present at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Nightgown
